title: Crash when using box selection on a SoftBody3D in the 3D mode of an embedded game window
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.dev4

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (4ebdc8743) - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 570.144) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### Issue description

If you try to use box selection to select a SoftBody3D in a running project (with game window embedding), you'll always get a crash:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c7a1d62f-e033-43c9-ad42-c21aa94bb8ff)


This occurs with both GodotPhysics3D and Jolt Physics.

### Steps to reproduce

- Add a SoftBody3D to a scene.
- Run a project, switch to the **3D** mode of the embedded game window so you can select objects in the 3D scene.
- Perform a box selection (left-click and drag) to select the SoftBody3D.
